Standard Rio Theatre Movie Pricing (as of May 23, 2025)

Regular Adult – $16.00
Concession (Member / Senior or Student with ID) – $13.00 *Please bring valid Student ID or Rio Theatre Movie Membership pass with you.

Rio & Park Theatre Movie Memberships for sale at our box office for only $30!

Membership includes both the Rio AND Park Theatre and saves you $3 off regular priced movies (as advertised – see individual website listing for exceptions), free re-fills on fountain soda and popcorn, special offers, promotions and sometimes even early ticket access and you’d be supporting Vancouver’s favourite independent theatre for a whole year!

All ticket purchases include a membership to the Vancouver Art House Society.

Vancouver Art House Society Membership

Under the laws of our province, only registered non-profit film societies such as VAHS are allowed to screen films that have not been classified by Consumer Protection BC. Therefore, only members of the Vancouver Art House Society are permitted to be present where a non-classified film is exhibited.

Viewing Membership

Definition: A Viewing member is any person 18 years of age* or older who purchases a ticket or pass to attend a Vancouver Art House Society film screening (which may not have been classified by Consumer Protection BC) or other events and functions.

Procedure: By purchasing a ticket or pass, individuals are automatically enrolled as non-voting Viewing Members of the Vancouver Art House Society for one year from the date of purchase of a ticket or pass. If multiple passes or tickets are purchased within a year, the latest purchase date will be the membership validity marker.

Responsibilities: All Viewing members are responsible for upholding the Vancouver Art House Society’s commitment to providing a safe, inclusive environment free of harassment and discrimination.

Entitlements: Viewing members are entitled to participate in the screenings of films and other events, activities, and functions hosted by the Vancouver Art House Society.

Revocation and denial of renewal: Vancouver Art House Society reserves the right to revoke or deny renewal of Viewing Membership, without notice or refund, of individuals who engage in conduct inconsistent with the Society’s bylaws and policies.
